_comment: Maps each atlas plate to its Pages URL and, optionally, the Qualtrics
graphics-library ID for the same image.
build-variants.py reads this to generate the two QSF variants.
When you upload a plate to your Qualtrics graphics library, paste its
IM_ id here so the qualtrics-hosted variant can pick it up.
Leave qualtrics_im null for plates you haven't uploaded.
